attachDirExists: The attachments folder {dir} already exists. Rename or delete that folder and try again.
claudeFailed:
Claude Code returned an error (code {code}). {detail}
Check that you are signed in: open Terminal, run "claude" and sign in with your account.
claudeBroken: Claude Code is installed but cannot run (incomplete installation). Open PowerShell and reinstall with irm https://claude.ai/install.ps1 | iex; then run claude once and sign in.
claudeBrokenMac: Claude Code is installed but cannot run (incomplete installation). Open Terminal and reinstall with curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash; then run claude once and sign in.
claudeTimeout: Claude Code took too long to respond. Try again in a few minutes.
imageTooBig: The image is larger than 20 MB. Make it smaller and paste it again.
imageType: You can only paste PNG, JPG, GIF or WebP images.
noTranscriptSection: The file has no "## Transcript" section.
outsideNotesDir: The meeting isn’t in the notes folder.
projectNameEmpty: Give the project a name (letters, numbers and spaces).
projectNameReserved: "{name}" is a reserved name. Choose another name for the project.
projectNotFound: Project "{name}" not found. Refresh the list and try again.
synthesisEmpty: Claude returned an empty synthesis. Try again.
synthesisEmptyIncremental: Claude returned an empty synthesis. Try "Rebuild from scratch".
synthesisNoSummaries: No meeting in this project has a summary yet. Generate the summaries and try again.
todoChanged: The meeting was changed outside the app and this to-do is no longer the same. Refresh the list and try again.
askNothing: I didn’t find anything about that in your meetings. Try other words.
askNothingProject: I didn’t find anything about that in the {project} project meetings. Try other words.
brainNoteNotFound: Meeting "{file}" not found. Use listar_reunioes or buscar to find the file.
brainNoSynthesis: This project has no synthesis yet. Open the project in Persist Notes and use "Rebuild from scratch".
projectTooDeep: Projects have only two levels: project and sub-project.
projectIsGroup: "{name}" is a project with sub-projects. Create a sub-project inside it.
parentHasMeetings: "{name}" has meetings and can't hold sub-projects. Choose another project or create a new one.
brainGroupNoSynthesis: This project only groups sub-projects and has no synthesis of its own. Ask for the synthesis of one of its sub-projects.
periodNoSummaries: No meeting in this period has a summary yet. Generate the meeting summaries and try again.
periodBadFormat: Claude replied in an unexpected format. Try again.
